_comment: Tracked deprecations awaiting removal. The deprecation-reaper workflow reads this file weekly, looks up when each entry's PR merged (its exact mergedAt timestamp), and once mergedAt + grace has elapsed it opens/refreshes a tracking issue and pings the owners. Entries whose PR is not merged yet are ignored, so the clock only starts at merge. Remove an entry once its functions are deleted.

deprecations.description: The Runtime API entry points that identify a command queue by raw id are deprecated in favor of overloads taking MeshCommandQueue& (tt-metal#51559): BeginTraceCapture(MeshDevice*, uint8_t) -> MeshDevice::begin_mesh_trace(MeshCommandQueue&), Synchronize(MeshDevice*, std::optional<uint8_t>, ...) -> Synchronize(MeshDevice&, ttsl::optional_reference<MeshCommandQueue>, ...), MeshDevice::{begin,end,replay}_mesh_trace(uint8_t, ...) -> the same members taking MeshCommandQueue&, and MeshEvent(uint32_t, MeshDevice*, uint32_t, const MeshCoordinateRange&) -> MeshEvent(uint32_t, MeshCommandQueue&, const MeshCoordinateRange&). All in-repo call sites are already migrated; the id-based overloads remain only for external callers during the grace period. The cleanup PR deletes them and their definitions in distributed.cpp, mesh_device.cpp and mesh_event.cpp, leaving only the MeshCommandQueue& forms.

Public headers moved from tt_metal/api/tt-metalium/ into concept folders (discovery/, mesh/, memory/, workload/, execution/, observability/, vocabulary/, data_formats/, utils/, legacy/, ...). The old paths are forwarding headers that warn; delete them (and their sources.cmake entries) after 2027-03-05.

ttnn.moreh_sum and ttnn.moreh_mean are deprecated in favor of ttnn.sum and ttnn.mean (tt-metal#58424). C++ callers get [[deprecated]]; Python callers get a FutureWarning on each call site. All in-repo callers are migrated; the ops remain only for external callers during the grace period. Note that with keepdim=False moreh_sum/moreh_mean keep reduced H/W dims as size 1, while ttnn.sum/ttnn.mean remove them. The cleanup PR deletes the moreh_sum and moreh_mean ops (sources, bindings, the ttnn.operations.moreh.sum/mean aliases and their tests); moreh_sum_backward and moreh_mean_backward are not part of this deprecation.

IDevice::sysmem_manager() is deprecated (tt-metal#64081): SystemMemoryManager was removed, and host command queues (HostCq, CqBacking) are internal to tt_metal with no public replacement. The deprecated pure virtual stays so that out-of-tree IDevice subclasses and callers still compile; every in-repo override throws. The cleanup PR deletes the declaration from mesh/legacy/device.hpp and mesh/mesh_device.hpp, the SystemMemoryManager forward declarations, and the throwing overrides in device.cpp and mesh_device.cpp.
